title: Charter Captain
description: Discover Lake Michigan charter captains & boats, check availability, get quotes, and book.
summary: Discover Lake Michigan charter captains & boats, check availability, get quotes, and book.
offersHint: Discover Lake Michigan charter captains & boats, check availability, get quotes, and book. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.chartercaptain.com/mcp/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_captains
toolsPreview.description: Search bookable charter captains, optionally filtered by harbor, with sorting and pagination. Returns a paginated list with starting price and rating.

toolsPreview.name: search_boats
toolsPreview.description: Search listed boats, optionally filtered by harbor, type, minimum capacity, and max hourly price, with sorting and pagination.

toolsPreview.name: get_captain
toolsPreview.description: Get a captain's full profile by tenant slug, enriched with a rating summary and the most recent reviews.

toolsPreview.name: get_boat
toolsPreview.description: Get a boat's full profile by id, enriched with a rating summary and the most recent reviews.

toolsPreview.name: list_harbors
toolsPreview.description: List active harbors, each with a count of active captains and listed boats operating there.

toolsPreview.name: check_availability
toolsPreview.description: Check a captain's or boat's availability. Provide exactly one of captainSlug or boatId. Omit date to get available dates for the next 90 days; provide both date (YYYY-MM-DD) and durationHours to get bookable time slots for that date.

toolsPreview.name: get_quote
toolsPreview.description: Get a non-binding price quote (in cents) for a charter or rental. Provide exactly one of captainSlug or boatId, plus durationId and partySize. Pass `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) whenever you know it: the rate then comes from the operator's rate card for that day — weekday vs weekend vs holiday, including any per-date price the operator set — so the quote matches what checkout charges. Without a date, pass pricingTierId instead; the quote then reflects that tier and may differ from checkout for the actual day. Optionally pass a partnerCode to preview a discount. Returns currency, totalCents, depositCents, balanceCents, pricingModel, and (when a code is given) a discountPreview.

toolsPreview.name: create_booking
toolsPreview.description: Book a charter with a captain and get a Stripe Checkout link for the charterer to complete payment. Optionally attach a partner/affiliate code to credit a referrer.

toolsPreview.name: create_boat_rental
toolsPreview.description: Book a bareboat boat rental and get a Stripe Checkout link for the charterer to complete payment. Requires captainChoiceRightAcknowledged: true (the charterer affirms their right to choose their own captain). Optionally attach a partner/affiliate code.
